name: Miner Johnson
summary: Deep in the Deadmines, Miner Johnson wanders among the Defias laborers. He is a seasoned miner who oversees excavation ahead of the heavy machinery, though he appears only now and then.

sections.title: A Rare Face in the Deep
sections.body: Miner Johnson works among the laborers digging beneath the Deadmines for Edwin VanCleef's hidden fortress. He waits in an alcove to the left, before the shredders in the Mast Room. Stronger and more aggressive than the other miners, he can be hard to find as he wanders the tunnels.

sections.title: Fueling the Defias War Machine
sections.body: Beneath Moonbrook, the Defias Brotherhood needs ore for weapons, reinforced shafts, and mechanical contraptions. Johnson and the other miners dig the mineral seams beneath Westfall. Anyone who enters his work area will find that he guards it fiercely.

faq.answer: Miner Johnson is a human miner allied with the Defias Brotherhood. He works in a side alcove among other laborers, before the goblin shredder deep in the Deadmines.

faq.q: Where exactly is Miner Johnson located?
faq.answer: Johnson works in the upper shafts of the Deadmines, before the room where Sneed and his shredder are found. Look for a small alcove to the left, where miners chip at the rock.

faq.q: Why isn't Miner Johnson always there?
faq.answer: Miner Johnson appears only occasionally in the Deadmines. Most groups find an ordinary miner in his place.

faq.q: Is Miner Johnson part of any quest?
aliases: does miner johnson have a quest
faq.answer: Miner Johnson has no formal bounty. He is an unexpected encounter for parties exploring the Deadmines.

faq.q: What is Miner Johnson's role in the Deadmines?
faq.answer: Miner Johnson helps the Defias Brotherhood dig up metal, stone, and other resources for its underground base and hidden juggernaut.

faq.q: Is Miner Johnson dangerous compared to other miners?
faq.answer: Yes. Miner Johnson is much tougher and hits harder than the ordinary miners. A group must work together to bring him down safely.

angles.text: For prospectors, Johnson shows the danger of mining beneath Westfall, where he guards mineral deposits with his pickaxe.
Defeating Johnson disrupts the ore supply feeding the Defias war machine beneath Moonbrook.
